resources.string: Used only for a manually armed, one-time structural experiment. When you start an inspection, it walks the accessibility tree of the currently active window of the one messaging app you selected as the test target and reports counts, tree depth and widget class names. It does not read, store, or transmit message text, it never inspects any app outside a short allowlist of messaging apps, and it runs once per button press rather than continuously. You must turn this service on yourself, and you can turn it off at any time.
